name: baby-gray-slime-on-enter-reveal-two-slime-draw
notes:
Baby Gray Slime (0hsncz1fz2, ALLY): "On Enter: You may reveal two Slime cards from your hand and/or memory. If you do, draw a card." Implemented as enterAbilities['0hsncz1fz2:0'] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php), which offers an MZMULTICHOOSE of exactly 2 Slime-subtype cards from hand/memory when at least 2 exist; customDQHandlers['0hsncz1fz2:0:Enter-1'] reveals both chosen cards and draws 1 if exactly 2 were picked. Its element is NORM, so no champion patch is needed.

Two Red Slime copies (mttsvbgl6f, SLIME subtype) are seeded directly into hand purely as reveal fodder -- they are never played, so neither their own element nor reserve cost matters. Baby Gray Slime itself is played for real from hand via a plain FSM action so its Enter trigger genuinely fires. The 2 reserve-payment clicks (myHand-0 x2) consume the lowest-index filler cards, leaving the 2 seeded Red Slime copies intact at myHand-5/myHand-6 -- confirmed live via FIXTURE_DEBUG hand-index tracking -- and the MZMULTICHOOSE decision's own Param echoed back exactly 'myHand-5&myHand-6' as the only 2 legal Slime-subtype choices, which the fixture answers verbatim. Hand count goes 7 (after cost/reveal setup) -> 8 (On Enter draw) -- confirmed live.

Only the base Enter clause is covered; Baby Gray Slime's separate Intercept keyword is a generically-implemented status/keyword and out of scope here.

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may reveal two Slime cards from your hand and/or memory. If you do, draw a card.
